breaking_news.headline: Meta considered buying Kalshi before developing its own prediction market app
breaking_news.summary: Mark Zuckerberg met with Kalshi's CEO last year about a potential deal, but talks did not move forward. Now Meta is making its own prediction market app.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. job market slows in June
breaking_news.summary: Employers added 57,000 jobs in June, the Labor Department said on Friday, as jobs growth slowed from the previous two months, while the unemployment rate ticked down to 4.2%.

breaking_news.headline: Trump earned more than $1 billion from crypto — but his investors didn't fare so well
breaking_news.summary: President Trump earned more than $1 billion in 2025 from cryptocurrency ventures. But there are thousands of investors who bought into some of those cryptocurrencies, and they stand to lose big.

breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools
breaking_news.summary: Don't have a pool during this hot summer? Rent one! Swimply is a platform that lets users rent private pools.

breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools
breaking_news.summary: The Airbnb-style company Swimply said there have been about 275,000 private pool reservations so far this year.

breaking_news.headline: But first, coffee: The drink that energized the American Revolution
breaking_news.summary: Colonial Americans were drinking coffee long before they dumped tea into Boston Harbor or fought a war for independence. The establishments that served it were already brewing revolutionary ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Egg producers settle with DOJ, states over price-fixing complaint
breaking_news.summary: Seventeen states and the Department of Justice have settled a case of alleged price-fixing by major egg producers. Egg prices soared in recent years but have since fallen sharply.

breaking_news.headline: Hate food waste? 7 creative ways to turn your leftovers into a new meal
breaking_news.summary: We asked our audience to share their favorite go-to recipes for leftovers. Here are seven dishes — like stuffed peppers and a biryani casserole — that can help you use up all your fridge scraps.

breaking_news.headline: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
breaking_news.summary: Fabiana was trapped in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes rocked Venezuela in June.

breaking_news.headline: More than 1,000 arrested as part of global human trafficking crackdown
breaking_news.summary: Interpol says the vast majority of the 2,070 victims or potential victims identified were women being trafficked for sex.

breaking_news.headline: Wildfire in southern France forces evacuation of 10,000 people
breaking_news.summary: Tour de France organisers ban spectators from stage three as a wildfire hits the Pyrénées-Orientales region.

breaking_news.headline: Huge crowds fill Tehran streets for Khamenei's funeral procession
breaking_news.summary: Many people were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance for the former supreme leader's war death.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-Syrian intelligence chief found guilty of torture and sexual abuse by Austrian court
breaking_news.summary: Two former Syrian officials went on trial in Vienna, Austria, accused of crimes against opponents of former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad

breaking_news.headline: Charlie Kirk's family attends hearing for suspect charged with his murder
breaking_news.summary: Tyler Robinson, 23, is accused of murdering Kirk, a key Trump ally and founder of youth organisation Turning Point USA.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 23 killed in Kyiv region
breaking_news.summary: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.

breaking_news.headline: Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review Balogun ban
breaking_news.summary: President Donald Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review United States striker Folarin Balogun's one-match suspension at the World Cup.

breaking_news.headline: ITV hits such as I'm a Celebrity to stay free to watch after Sky takeover
breaking_news.summary: Sky boss Dana Strong's comments came as the channel announces it is buying ITV's media and entertainment divisions in a £1.6bn deal.

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs and shrinks Xbox in 'significant restructure'
breaking_news.summary: The sweeping layoffs equate to 2.1% of Microsoft's workforce, with 1,600 immediate job losses at Xbox.

breaking_news.headline: Robots available for rent: But what can they do?
breaking_news.summary: Robotics tech is changing fast, so for many it makes sense to rent a robot.

breaking_news.headline: Can China repeat its EV success with robotaxis?
breaking_news.summary: China's self-driving car firms have been given a headstart by the country's EV supply chain as they expand globally.
